definition: Michael Truell is an American software engineer and entrepreneur.
details: Led the creation of Cursor, the AI-native code editor that redefined how software and AI engineers write and refactor code. He is the co-founder and chief executive officer of Cursor, an AI coding agent company.

explainer.lead: Michael Truell is an American entrepreneur.

contributions.name: Truell was born in New York City and studied at the Horace Mann School, where he met Aman Sanger, a future co-founder.
During his early years, Truell developed an interest in programming and worked on improving reinforcement learning for simple robotic tasks.
In 2022, Truell co-founded Cursor with Sualeh Asif, Aman Sanger and Arvid Lunnemark, whom he met while studying at MIT.
